summary: Iter94 — verified BUG FIX #1 (onboarding modal debounced typing) via Playwright + 4 SEC fixes via 18 pytest cases. All 18 backend security tests PASSED (LMS credentials admin-gate, custom-invoices admin-gate, portal-token 401/403/200 on /user/bookings, reschedule, cancel, /school-student/profile GET+PATCH, /school-student/receipt, public LMS report regression). Frontend typing bug is FIXED — typed 'abc123' burst into MOU Document Link inside the Onboarding Workflow modal for a Converted school (Gokuldham High School): input kept focus, all 6 chars preserved, ZERO 'Step updated' toasts during typing, and only 1 PATCH /schools/{id}/onboarding-step/mou_signing fired for the entire burst (vs pre-fix expected 6 PATCH + 6 toasts + 6 refetches).
critical_code_review_comments: auth_utils._normalize_phone strips '+', spaces, dashes, and leading 91/0 — good coverage. Consider also handling '+91-XXXXX-XXXXX' hyphenated formats explicitly if inbound sources vary.
routes/users.py verify_otp returns portal_token in ALL branches (summer_camp / school_student / default) — good, no exception path leaks user data without token.
handleStepFieldChange stores debounce timers per (schoolId, stepKey, field) — correct, prevents debounce clobbering across different fields.

handleUpdateOnboardingStep(silent) skips fetchInquiries when silent — good, but consider a final non-silent refetch after modal close to sync progress-bar counters on the cards. (Not blocking — cards re-fetch on next interaction.)

lms_api.py get_lms_school_users uses inline `if user.get('role') != 'admin'` — consistent with custom_invoices._require_admin. Consider extracting a shared `require_admin` dependency to DRY the check across future routes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — typing bug fix verified via burst + rapid keyboard typing

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iter94_security_and_portal_token.py for portal-token regression. It exercises 401/403/200 on all portal endpoints and asserts the /public/lms-report path still returns 404 (not 401/403). For onboarding-modal typing regressions, open a Converted school's 'View →' onboarding button and burst-type into 'MOU document URL' — expect ≤1 PATCH per debounce window and no per-keystroke 'Step updated' toast. Playwright's synthetic typing is slow (each type() call ~1s due to React rerender overhead) so use page.keyboard.type(text, delay=0) or JS setNativeValue burst as done in this iteration.
rca of the issue: N/A — both the debouncing bug fix and the four security enforcement points are working as designed.
